reuse.why: Routes setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the averages through the existing getMonthWideCategories selection with a new flag and introduces a shared MonthWideBudgetArgs type, but copyPreviousMonth keeps and patches its own inline hidden check.

duplication.why: The include-hidden decision is implemented twice: as a SQL fragment in getMonthWideCategories and as a JS condition in copyPreviousMonth.

placement.why: The rule sits in the month-wide category selection in budget/actions.ts, except for copyPreviousMonth, which still decides it in its own loop.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their argument type, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Clean shared argument type and one selection function for most actions; the hidden rule still lives in two forms that must be kept in sync.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/group-hidden exclusion (now with the flag) inline instead of through getMonthWideCategories' selection.

disguised_duplication.where: The same include-hidden rule appears as an SQL WHERE fragment (hiddenFilter) in getMonthWideCategories and as a !includeHiddenCategories && (hidden || group_hidden) check in copyPreviousMonth.
